p: secret place of the most High: He who makes God his defence and trust will perceive his protection to be a most sure safeguard.
I will say of the LORD: Being assured of this protection, he prays to the Lord.
snare of the fowler: That is, God's help is most ready for us, whether Satan assails us secretly which he calls a snare, or openly which is here meant by the pestilence.
truth shall be thy shield and: That is, his faithful keeping of promises to help you in your need.
Thou shalt not be afraid for: The care that God has over his is sufficient to defend them from all dangers.
eyes shalt thou behold and see: The godly will have some experience of God's judgements against the wicked even in this life, but they will see it fully at that day when all things will be revealed.

For he shall give his angels: God has not appointed one angel to every man, but many to be ministers of his providence to keep and defend his in their calling, which is the way to walk in without tempting God.
young lion and the dragon shalt: You will not only be preserved from all evil, but overcome it whether it is secret or open.
Because he hath set his love: To assure the faithful of God's protection, he brings in God to confirm the same.
long life will I satisfy him: For he is content with that life that God gives for by death the shortness of this life is recompensed with immortality.
